ROOT.scriptdef: CREATE TABLE #XLIndexesFileGroups (indName VARCHAR(100),fgName VARCHAR(100))

IF EXISTS( SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'CDN.BIPointRaportElem') and name=N'BREBIPointRaportDef' ) BEGIN INSERT INTO #XLIndexesFileGroups SELECT IND.name,FG.name FROM sys.indexes IND JOIN sys.filegroups FG ON FG.data_space_id = IND.data_space_id WHERE IND.name = 'BREBIPointRaportDef' DROP INDEX BREBIPointRaportDef on CDN.BIPointRaportElem; END

IF EXISTS( SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'CDN.BIPointRaportElem') and name=N'BREBIPointRaportId' ) BEGIN INSERT INTO #XLIndexesFileGroups SELECT IND.name,FG.name FROM sys.indexes IND JOIN sys.filegroups FG ON FG.data_space_id = IND.data_space_id WHERE IND.name = 'BREBIPointRaportId' DROP INDEX BREBIPointRaportId on CDN.BIPointRaportElem; END

SET NOCOUNT ON;DECLARE @INDSQL VARCHAR(max) SET @INDSQL = ' CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX BREBIPointRaportId ON CDN.BIPointRaportElem ( BRE_RaportId , BRE_KontekstId , BRE_BRDId ) ON '+ISNULL((SELECT QUOTENAME(fgName) FROM #XLIndexesFileGroups WHERE indName = 'BREBIPointRaportId'),QUOTENAME('PRIMARY')) EXEC(@INDSQL);SET NOCOUNT OFF; ;
